purpose: Customer profile for analysis/impact_model.py. hour_value is a cited public figure; every field under assumptions is an ASSUMPTION (a modelling choice, not a measurement) and is labelled as such wherever it is used.

hour_value.table: Quick Facts: Software Developers, Quality Assurance Analysts, and Testers, row "2025 Median Pay"
hour_value.occupation: Software Developers, Quality Assurance Analysts, and Testers (BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook group)
hour_value.reference_period: May 2025 (the page's pay data is labelled May 2025; the Pay tab says the data are from the Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics program)
hour_value.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook
hour_value.page_title: Software Developers, Quality Assurance Analysts, and Testers : Occupational Outlook Handbook: : U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
hour_value.fetch_method: WebFetch (page converted to text and read back); figure transcribed from that text
hour_value.also_on_page: Pay tab: "The median annual wage for software developers was $135,980 in May 2025." (annual only; no hourly figure for software developers alone is given, so the group's stated hourly median is used)
hour_value.not_used: https://www.bls.gov/oes/current/oes151252.htm and https://www.bls.gov/oes/current/oes_nat.htm returned the OEWS index page, not the occupation table, on the fetch date; no third-party source was used
hour_value.meaning: median hourly wage, not a loaded labour cost; no overhead multiplier is applied

notes.turns_per_session: the R2 session length (40 turns); used to scale a per-turn time delta to a session
notes.single_shot_calls_per_dev_per_day: calls shaped like the workload pack (one prompt, one answer), outside agent sessions
notes.co_runner_share: share of sessions that run next to a heavy co-running job
notes.cloud_session_share: share of agent sessions sent to a cloud model
notes.device/model/runtime: the status-quo configuration the profile is priced at; scenario_runtime is the one-flag alternative priced next to it
notes.cloud_model/cloud_tier: escalation target: the mid-tier model of results/cloud_prices_20261008.json's selection, Standard tier
